title: National Investment And Infrastructure Fund
definition: NIIF is India's first quasi-sovereign wealth fund set up by the Government of India in 2015 to maximize economic impact through infrastructure investments in commercially viable projects, both greenfield and brownfield.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Infrastructure, Investment Models, Mobilization of Resources) and Prelims (Economic Governance, Financial Institutions).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Investment And Infrastructure Fund.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian financial system, infrastructure financing, and public-private partnerships.
